snippets.description: New ROLE_RANK total order (user=0 < staff=1 < admin=2) + roleRank/isDowngrade pure helpers, exposed on the existing authService object. Single source of truth for 'is this a downgrade' shared by both call sites.

setRole() pre-reads the current DB role, then after a successful UPDATE revokes all refresh tokens ONLY on a downgrade. Mirrors setLocked()'s existing post-update revoke pattern. currentRow null -> revoke check skipped; the pre-existing NotFoundError throw still fires.

The existing single DB lookup now selects `role` alongside `is_deleted` (no extra round trip). Role-mismatch block sits AFTER the is_deleted guard and BEFORE the isActive() check (E2 binding ordering) — downgrade rejects + revokes exactly like the is_deleted path; upgrade sets effectiveRole from the DB and continues. effectiveRole replaces payload.role in newPayload.
